events.title: 한나라 재상 가문에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born into a family of Han chancellors
events.description: 전국시대 한(韓)나라에서 다섯 임금을 내리 섬긴 재상 집안에 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born into a family that had served as chancellors to five successive kings of the state of Han during the Warring States period.

events.title: 박랑사에서 진시황을 저격하다 실패하다
events.title_en: He attempted to assassinate the First Emperor at Bolangsha
events.description: 진나라에 망한 한나라의 원수를 갚으려 박랑사를 지나는 진시황의 행렬에 역사를 매복시켜 철퇴를 던지게 했다. 옆 수레를 맞혀 저격은 실패했다.
events.description_en: Seeking revenge for Han's fall to Qin, he had a hired strongman ambush the First Emperor's procession at Bolangsha and hurl an iron hammer at his carriage. The hammer struck the wrong carriage, and the attempt failed.

events.title: 하비에 숨어 황석공에게 병법을 배우다
events.title_en: He hid in Xiapi and learned strategy from Huangshi Gong
events.description: 저격 실패 뒤 이름을 바꾸고 하비에 숨었다. 다리 위에서 만난 노인 황석공이 신을 주워오라 세 번 시험한 뒤 태공병법서를 전해 주었다.
events.description_en: After the failed attempt he changed his name and went into hiding in Xiapi. There an old man, Huangshi Gong, tested him three times by making him fetch a dropped sandal on a bridge, then passed him a treatise on the art of war.

events.title: 진에 맞서 군사를 일으키고 유방과 합류하다
events.title_en: He raised troops against Qin and joined Liu Bang
events.description: 진나라에 맞선 봉기가 곳곳에서 터지자 자신도 군사를 일으켰다. 곧 유방의 군에 합류해 그의 책사가 되었다.
events.description_en: When uprisings against Qin broke out everywhere, he raised his own troops. He soon joined Liu Bang's army and became his strategist.

events.title: 홍문의 연회에서 유방을 구하다
events.title_en: He saved Liu Bang at the Feast at Hong Gate
events.description: 항우가 홍문의 연회에서 유방을 죽이려 하자 번쾌와 함께 나서 유방을 무사히 빠져나가게 했다.
events.description_en: When Xiang Yu plotted to kill Liu Bang at the Feast at Hong Gate, he worked with Fan Kuai to get Liu Bang safely away.

events.title: 한신·팽월과 연합을 이끌어 항우를 무너뜨리다
events.title_en: He arranged the alliance with Han Xin and Peng Yue that broke Xiang Yu
events.description: 한신과 팽월을 유방 편으로 끌어들이도록 이끌었다. 이 연합이 해하 전투에서 항우를 무너뜨리는 결정적 힘이 되었다.
events.description_en: He guided the alliance that brought Han Xin and Peng Yue to Liu Bang's side. That alliance became the decisive force that broke Xiang Yu at the Battle of Gaixia.

events.title: 유후에 봉해지다
events.title_en: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Liu
events.description: 유방이 황제에 올라 한나라를 세우자 유후로 봉해졌다.
events.description_en: When Liu Bang became emperor and founded the Han dynasty, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Liu.

events.title: 장안을 도읍으로 삼도록 권하다
events.title_en: He advised making Chang'an the capital
events.description: 낙양이 아닌 관중의 장안을 도읍으로 삼도록 유방에게 권했다. 지형이 견고해 방어에 유리하다는 이유였다.
events.description_en: He advised Liu Bang to make Chang'an in the Guanzhong region the capital rather than Luoyang, arguing that its terrain gave it a stronger defensive position.

events.title: 정치에서 물러나 수양에 전념하다
events.title_en: He withdrew from politics to pursue self-cultivation
events.description: 나라가 안정되자 스스로 정사에서 물러나 곡기를 줄이고 도가의 수양법을 따랐다.
events.description_en: Once the dynasty was stable, he withdrew from state affairs on his own, cut back on food, and took up Daoist practices of self-cultivation.

events.title: 세상을 떠나다
events.description_en: He died. He was posthumously honored with the title Marquis Wencheng.
